title: Planter or gardening container
abstract: A low-maintenance and water-conserving container-gardening system used indoors or outdoors to grow plants, vegetables, herbs, fruits, and flowers. Combining the advantages/benefits of natural bacteria-enriched soil with the advantages/benefits of hydroponics to feed plant roots oxygenated nutrient/fluid precisely at the time of need, the system uses one or more gardening containers each having water-elevating structure causing slow and consistent upward flow of nutrient/fluid into the soil, and nutrient/fluid drainage-facilitating structure that directs surplus nutrient/fluid away from plant roots when the pump stops. Support for gardening containers includes nutrient/fluid reservoirs and frames, with multiple gardening containers optionally connected together in stepped gravity-feed arrangements. Use of renewable energy is preferred, and solar-assist may be employed with timers and pumps. System advantages include optional compact configurations for porch/balcony/patio use, moderated root temperature, longer growing seasons, multiple harvests, provisions for rainwater reservoir replenishment, and use of commonly-available, inexpensive, and locally-sourced soils, nutrients, and filtration media.

title: A simple recirculating aquaculture system and method for large spiny loach
abstract: The present invention provides a simple recirculating aquaculture system and method for large spiny carp. The aquaculture system includes a culture pond, a purification pond, a filter device, an NFT pipeline hydroponic device, a pneumatic system and a heating temperature controller; the water in the culture pond After being extracted by the air-lifting water device and filtered by the filter equipment, it enters the purification pool. The water in the purification pool is extracted by the air-lifting water device to the pipeline hydroponic device, and is absorbed and utilized by the roots of aquatic plants and transformed and decomposed by the beneficial bacteria attached to the roots. Complete the purification treatment of the aquaculture water body, and finally return to the purification pool through the water outlet; the water in the purification pool is extracted from the bottom drain pipe through the air lifter to the aquaculture pool, thereby realizing the closed loop of the entire aquaculture system waterway. According to the breeding density and water quality, the present invention can realize the circulating aquaculture of the large spiny loach by adjusting the trachea control valves on each device, avoiding the frequent discharge of water from affecting the growth of the big spiny squid, and at the same time, the breeding method saves water resources, Reduce energy consumption and improve economic benefits.

The constituent material of the storage tank is composed mainly of synthetic resin. An engagement mechanism between the storage tank and the platform has an allowance that is relatively movable in the longitudinal direction of the storage tank. title: Method for improving concentration of medicinal components in licorice plants
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide means for improving the concentration of a medicinal component in culturing a Glycyrrhiza plant.SOLUTION: A hydroponics method of a Glycyrrhiza plant for increasing the content of a specific medicinal component in the root comprises the steps of: (1) raising the Glycyrrhiza plant in a closed system facility under a long day condition in which a temperature of a culture medium is adjusted to 20 to 35°C; (2) performing low-temperature culture in which the culture medium is controlled to 19°C or less before harvest; (3) storing the root under the condition of 1 to 30°C after harvest; (4) and drying the root under the condition of 20 to 50°C.

title: Method and apparatus for hydroponics of plant
abstract: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for hydroponics of plants enabling ingredient balance in culture solution containing moisture stress-imparting ingredients to be easily and constantly regulated.  <P>SOLUTION: The method for hydroponics of plants comprises supplying culture solution to the root area of plants to carry out cultivation; wherein two kinds of culture solutions comprising a basic culture solution necessary for growth of the plants and a moisture stress-imparting culture solution giving moisture stress to the plants are supplied to the root area of the plants via independent supply systems respectively, the remaining part of the supplied culture solution not absorbed in the root area of the plants is corrected as surplus solution; the surplus solution is made to flow back to a storage means of the moisture stress-imparting culture solution to be reused after regulating an EC value of the moisture stress-imparting culture solution so as to fall within a predetermined range.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI

title: Vegetable soilless cultivation substrate and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a vegetable soilless culture substrate, which is mainly made of the following raw material components: hemp husk, pine sawdust, carbonized rice husk, shea butter, farmyard manure, humic acid, vermiculite, brewer's grains, Tea seed hulls, mulberry leaves and filter mud. The vegetable soilless cultivation substrate of the invention has loose substrate, good permeability and excellent ventilation performance, and plays a role in promoting the growth of vegetables. Due to the addition of hemp husks and tea seed husks, on the one hand, waste resources are reused, turning waste into treasure, and increasing the added value of crop waste. The survival rate and yield of new vegetable seedlings are improved, and the cultivated vegetables are rich in nutrition and high in vitamins and trace elements. A diverging track system is provided in one of the growth chambers for handling the plants in a prescribed manner and guiding them through the chamber. As the plants are moved through such chamber, increased space is automatically provided for plant growth. The installation is well suited for growing plants hydroponically.

title: A pre-adjustment EC proportional opening valve for tank-mixing water and fertilizer machine
abstract: The utility model provides a tank-mixing type water fertilizer machine pre-adjusting EC proportional opening valve, which relates to the technical field of agricultural automation soilless cultivation irrigation. The tank-mixing type water fertilizer machine pre-adjusts the EC proportional opening valve, which includes a mounting plate, and two valve pipes are arranged under the mounting plate, and the upper surface of each valve pipe is fixedly connected with a connecting plate. The upper ends are all fixedly connected with the bottom surface of the mounting plate, and each valve tube is provided with a valve plate inside, and each valve plate is provided with a rotating shaft fixedly plugged inside. The tank-mixed water and fertilizer machine pre-adjusts the EC proportional opening valve. By setting the EC detection unit, swing rod, connecting rod and short rod, the EC detection unit provides real-time feedback by detecting the EC value. The fertilizer solution is injected into the mixing tank together, and the excess return fertilizer solution is effectively used, which solves the problem that the return solution generally exists in the soilless cultivation irrigation process of the existing water and fertilizer integration system, and if it is not used, it will lead to the waste of water and fertilizer solution.

title: Hydroponics system
abstract: Provided herein is a system for hydroponics growing of plants. A hydroponics system described herein includes: a water tank; a pump; a supply manifold; a drain manifold; a plurality of lower support brackets, each lower support bracket having a lower support bracket cup; a plurality of upper support brackets, each upper support bracket having an upper support bracket cup, where water is supplied from the water tank to each upper support bracket cup via the supply manifold, where water is returned to the water tank from the lower support bracket cup via the drain manifold. title: PLANT FOR THE INDUSTRIAL CULTIVATION OF MICROALGAE SUCH AS SPIRULINA, SCENEDESMUS, CHLORELLA AND SIMILAR
abstract: The plant consists of a plurality of transparent, rectilinear, aligned, circular, and / or oval, and / or elliptical, containers inside which the microalgae culture is fed, and elements of excitations of vibrations placed inside the same containers. These exciters immersed in the culture will generate a series of acoustic waves which will be able to produce adequate agitation for the development of the culture. Their aim is to achieve greater and faster growth of the crop, avoiding the stratification problems of the same crop. To obtain this result, these vibration exciters will be able to produce a wave that will move the culture in the most homogeneous way possible for the whole volume of the container. The plant is part of the biotechnology sector, for hydroponic and microbiological crops. The plant is designed to optimize or replace current biotechnologies for the production of biomass, deriving from microbiological crops.

abstract: The utility model relates to agriculture, namely, means for growing and feeding animals hydroponic feed. The application of the proposed device can increase the productivity of plants and control the ecological purity of the feed.

title: Hydroponic indoor greening system capable of self-cleaning of plants
abstract: The present invention discloses an indoor greening system using a hydroponic method. The hydroponic indoor greening system according to the present invention has the effect of being usable even at a corner where a wall meets another wall by including the outer case (100) composed of two rows, the plate-shaped hinge (310), the rotating hinge (320), and the wheel (330), it may be opened and closed by rotating inward, being able to create various planting arrangements since the planted plants may be replaced and moved as desired including the planting pot (240) and the planting rail (210), continuously supplying water and nutrients to the roots of plants by including the porous sponge (241) and the paper-type complete fertilizer (242), and increasing cleanliness because the water does not splash out to the outside even when sprayed at high pressure since the control unit recognizes the switch and self-cleaning is performed only when the external case (100) is closed.
publication_description: Official gazette of the unexamined patents

title: A hydroponic seedling potted flower pot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of plant cultivation, and particularly relates to a water-cultured seedling pot-culture flowerpot which comprises a base, wherein a glass cylinder is arranged on the base, an annular plate is arranged on the top surface of the glass cylinder, a bearing tray is arranged on the annular plate, and a circular groove and an air vent are formed in the bearing tray; a vertical plate is fixedly arranged at the outer edge of the annular plate, a door-shaped frame is horizontally matched on the vertical plate in a sliding manner, and a roller which is matched with the outer side wall of the glass cylinder in a rolling manner is vertically and rotatably arranged at the inner end of the door-shaped frame; a horizontal supporting spring is arranged between the door-shaped frame and the vertical plate; the annular plate is provided with a cleaning mechanism. The hydroponic seedling potted plant flowerpot combs the root system of the seedlings in the glass cylinder from top to bottom through the combing mechanism, prevents the root systems of the seedlings from being wound together to form a bulk shape, and ensures that all the root systems can fully absorb water and nutrients in nutrient solution; and algae attached to the inner side wall of the glass cylinder can be scraped, so that interference of the algae on observing the liquid level of the nutrient solution in the flowerpot is avoided.

title: Asparagus hydroponic nutrient solution
abstract: The invention discloses a hydroponic nutrient solution for asparagus bamboo, which comprises the following components, and the carrier is distilled water: potassium nitrate, ammonium nitrate, calcium nitrate, potassium dihydrogen phosphate, magnesium sulfate, copper sulfate, manganese sulfate, zinc sulfate , boric acid, sodium molybdate, disodium iron edetate, polyhexamethylene guanidine. The hydroponic nutrient solution supplements the necessary medium and micronutrient elements, has balanced and comprehensive nutrition, and a reasonable ratio, can fully meet the nutrient requirements of asparagus bamboo, and is easy to absorb. It can enhance the stress resistance of plants, promote plant growth, and make Asparagus bamboo more ornamental.

title: Improved regulating structure of water ploughing device
abstract: The invention discloses an improved hydroponic device adjustment structure, comprising: a frame, which is composed of a plurality of vertical poles and a plurality of horizontal poles, wherein each vertical pole has a groove and defines two side walls, and each side wall has a hook portion inwardly facing in a barb shape; a plurality of planting tubes, which have a predetermined outer diameter, and each of which is provided with a water stop cover at both ends; each planting tube has a plurality of accommodating through holes penetrating the outer edge wall on one side, and each accommodating through hole is provided with at least one water outlet at a predetermined position on the opposite side; a plurality of drainage pipes, which have a A water-stop gasket is sleeved on the outer edge of the drain pipe in a close fit and is locked at the water outlet of each planting pipe; a plurality of clamping parts are composed of two clips and a locking piece, and each clip has a through hole at one end for each clip to be locked with each other through the locking piece, and a hook end is provided at the other end, which cooperates with the hook part of the side wall of the vertical pole of each frame to be in a hooked state; thereby, a hydroponic cultivation device with adjustable spacing and level is provided, which can facilitate replacement and adjustment of the hydroponic device function.

title: Plant receiving container inserted into container for hydroponics
A kind of method for culturing seedlings of azalea soilless cultivation
abstract: The invention discloses a kind of method for culturing seedlings of azalea soilless cultivation, including seed soaking, sand storage vernalization, matrix breeding and water planting process, through the azalea seed of acquisition statement after clear water and heteroauxin are impregnated and cleaned, sand storage vernalization is carried out in clean river sand, the azalea sprigging of 2-3 Zhousheng is cultivated into seedling medium, it finally moves to and carries out water planting in the water container equipped with nutrient solution, until blooming.The present invention first cultivates azalea seedling in soilless culture substrate, after plant takes root, then is transferred in mill water culture nutrient solution and is cultivated, it can make its Rapid Rooting in this way, the plant root of cultivation is more flourishing, and plant strain growth is more vigorous, flowering time is extended, ornamental value is higher；Present invention process is easy to operate, and flower seedling growth is fast, and pattern is bright-coloured, and no disease and pests harm occurs, and Integral Flowering rate is high, and flower diameter is big, has preferable economic benefit, social benefit and ecological benefits.

title: Hydroponics equipment
abstract: The cultivation bed tray has a cultivation bed tray having a bottom and at least two side walls and a sprayer for spraying the nutrient solution, and the cultivation bed tray can hold the plant support at a position away from the bottom of the cultivation bed tray. A hydroponic cultivation apparatus is disclosed, which is located at the bottom of a cultivation bed tray and includes an ultrasonic transducer and a holding portion for holding the ultrasonic transducer. Also, the nutrient solution sprayed by flowing the nutrient solution to the bottom of the cultivation bed tray to at least contact the roots of the crop, or by providing the nutrient solution to the bottom of the cultivation bed tray and spraying the nutrient solution is at least the crop. Also disclosed are methods of producing crops using hydroponic cultivation equipment to contact the roots of the bed.

title: A kind of Microspore of Brassica napus seedling water planting culture solution and the method for more summer culture
abstract: The invention discloses a hydroponic culture medium of Brassica napus microspore seedlings and a method for over-summer culture. The steps include inserting Brassica napus microspore seedlings into the culture medium for hydroponics; The culture medium with the same concentration of paclobutrazol was replaced every 30 days thereafter; the culture medium without paclobutrazol was replaced every 20 days before field transplanting; ten Beginning in mid-March, the hydroponically grown microspore seedlings were transplanted into the experimental field and soil irrigation was carried out. The method provided by the invention reduces the seedling loss caused by the pollution of traditional B5 medium during the oversummering process of rape microspore seedlings, gets rid of the sterile environment after the microspore regeneration plant is developed and takes shape, completely solves the loss caused by pollution in the later stage, and saves money The cost of medicines and reagents for microspore seedlings to survive the summer.

title: Hydroponics
abstract: The present invention provides a water-culturing device including a water tank; a culturing bed which is formed on the upper side of the water tank and which includes the open top surface and an internal receiving space; cup-shaped culturing cuts which are separately arranged in the longitudinal direction of the culturing bed to be inclined toward the vertical direction and which includes a plurality of intake holes on the outer circumference; a jetting unit which is formed on the upper side of the culturing cups and which jets the water of the water tank to the intake holes; a circulation unit which including a first pipe of which both end are connected to the water tank and the jetting unit respectively and which supplies the water of the water tank to the jetting unit and a second pipe of which both ends are connected to the culturing bed and the water tank respectively and which re-supplies the water fill inside the receiving space to the water tank; and a water level control unit which is arranged between the culturing bed and the second pipe and which discharges the water filled inside the receiving space after a predetermined time and controls the water level of the receiving space. As the present invention discharges a culture fluid after a predetermined time, the present invention prevents a root of a plant from being rotten by preventing a root of a plant from being always exposed to the culture fluid. and the present invention makes the culture fluid be rapidly supplied and absorbed to the whole root by arranging the culturing cups to be inclined and directly jetting the culture fluid from the sides of the culturing cups, thereby promoting the growth of plants.
publication_description: Official gazette of the unexamined patents

title: A plant root hydroponic device
abstract: The utility model discloses a plant divides root hydroponic device, include: a culture tube and two adapters; a root-dividing partition plate suitable for dividing the tube cavity of the culture tube into a first liquid storage cavity and a second liquid storage cavity is arranged in the culture tube, a plurality of seedling fixing rings are arranged at the top of the culture tube, and the bottoms of the seedling fixing rings are communicated with the first liquid storage cavity and the second liquid storage cavity; two adapters can be respectively sleeved at two ends of the culture tube, and the adapters are provided with a first through hole communicated with the first liquid storage cavity and a second through hole communicated with the second liquid storage cavity. The seedling fixing ring is used for fixing plants, and the root system of the plants is divided into two parts under the action of the root dividing partition plate and respectively extends into the first liquid storage cavity and the second liquid storage cavity; the first through-hole of the left and right sides of culture tube, the second through-hole of the left and right sides of culture tube are connected with the hose and draw different nutrient solutions through the actuating pump respectively to make the nutrient solution in first stock solution chamber and the second stock solution intracavity flow mutually noninterfere, realize allotting the nutrient solution fast, reach the purpose of root branch water planting.

title: A soilless cultivation method for special-shaped watermelons in pots and pots
abstract: The invention relates to a method for cultivating watermelons in special shapes in pots in a greenhouse without using soil, and the method comprises the following steps: building the greenhouse on the even fertile sandy soil with good irrigation and drainage effects; sowing watermelon seeds in flower pots with the diameters of 40cm; culturing watermelon seedlings by hole trays, wherein a watermelon-seedling culturing medium is prepared by mixing fafard peat, perlite and carbendazim at the mass ratio of 200:50:1; transplanting the watermelon seedlings into flower pots after the watermelon seedlings have two leaves; growing the watermelon seedlings by hanging vines; pruning the watermelon seedlings with two to three vines being left; pollinating the flowers of the watermelon seedlings manually before 10 a.m. every day; and setting the fruit one week later; making moulds for the watermelons in special shapes from non-toxic polypropylene plastic; sleeving the young fruits with good shapes and long stems by the moulds 10-15 days after pollinating; overturning the moulds about every six days; and harvesting the watermelons after the watermelons grow fully in the moulds to have the shapes of the moulds and are 80% manure. The method is suitable for producing the pollution-free products such as the watermelons in special shapes in the greenhouse, guaranteeing the high quality and high yield of the watermelons, improving the ornamental value of the watermelons, realizing the high-grade production of the watermelons and increasing the production efficiency of farmers.

title: A water-saving vegetable growing hydroponic system
abstract: The invention discloses a water-saving vegetable planting hydroponic system. Its structure includes a controller, a device shell, a support seat, and a movable hydroponic device. The support seat is located on the side of the device shell away from the controller, and is connected with the device shell. The body is formed into an integrated structure by mechanical welding. The movable hydroponic device is parallel to the upper and lower sides of the support seat, and is embedded in the device shell. The controller is movably installed on the front end surface of the device shell. , the beneficial effects of the present invention: through the cooperation of the arc-shaped plate and the arc-shaped block, through the gradual upward curved surface structure with the multiple upward through-slot type movable structures formed by the multi-segment barrier, and finally in the way of the arc surface turning Guide the direction of water flow, so that the water injection work is carried out without touching the roots of vegetables, which can well protect the roots of vegetables and prevent dead seedlings.

title: Soilless culture device for sweet corn seed cultivation and use method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of corn cultivation equipment, and particularly discloses a soilless cultivation device for sweet corn seed cultivation and a use method thereof, wherein the soilless cultivation device comprises a placement ring, a rotating mechanism and a control device, wherein the top of the placement ring is fixedly connected with an incubator; the protection mechanism is fixedly arranged on the rotating mechanism. Along with corns grow out of stems, the motor can be started to intermittently and reciprocally work, the driving rod connected with the output end of the motor drives the top cover to rotate, so that corn plants receive uniform sunlight irradiation, development of each corn plant is guaranteed, the inner engagement ring on the outer surface of the culture box and the outer engagement ring on the top of the culture box are mutually staggered when the top cover rotates, namely the culture box can be driven to rotate along with rotation of the top cover, uniformity of the corn plants under sunlight irradiation is further improved, irradiation dead angles are greatly reduced, and development effects of the corn plants are guaranteed.

title: Hydroponic Cultivation System by Acoustic Vibration
abstract: PURPOSE: A hydroponic culture system using acoustic vibration is provided to promote the growth of edible crops by emitting acoustic vibration to the crops dipped in culture fluid in a hydroponic culture bed. CONSTITUTION: A hydroponic culture system using acoustic vibration comprises the following: a main body(c) including a bezel(b) on the upper side; a hydroponic culture bed(a) installed inside the bezel; an acoustic module directly attached to the surface of a side of the main body without punching holes; a housing shaped as a cup for inserting seedlings of edible crops wrapped in a sponge and sealed with a top cover; and a bracket for fixing a speaker. Acoustic energy emitted from the acoustic module vibrates the surface of a side of the main body and vibrates culture fluid in the hydroponic culture bed to transferr the vibration to the roots of the edible crops.

title: Water and soil combination cultivation flowerpot
abstract: A water-soil combination cultivation flower pot for indoor flower cultivation, which provides two complementary growth environments of soil and water for flowers at the same time by combining soil culture pots and hydroponic pots, and prolongs the watering and fertilization cycles of flowers , so that the water-soil combination cultivation flower pot has the characteristics of drought and waterlogging drainage, flower pot moisturizing, water saving and fertilizer saving, low cost, convenient maintenance, clean and environmental protection, beautiful and practical, and the like.

title: Method of reproduction of tea tick trefoil (hedysarum theinum krasnob)
abstract:

The invention is a method of reproduction of tea tick trefoil, when the matured sterilized seeds of tea tick trefoil (Hedysarum theinum Krasnob) are planted in the Murashige-Skoog culture medium for insertion into tissue of the culture, in 20-30 days the developed shoots are transplanted to the MS medium of reproduction, then the formed conglomerates of microshoots are divided and transplanted to the media comprising 1.0 BAP + L-glutamine and adenine sulphate 100 mg/l. title: Apparatus for producing plants
abstract: APPARATUS FOR PRODUCING PLANTS                Noel Davis William M. Dreier Stanley C. Rustad ABSTRACT OF THE DISCLOSURE       An installation for continuously growing plants which includes one or more growth chambers wherein alternate periods of lightness and darkness are provided, and the environmental conditions are controlled.  The plants are individually supported, and transported through the growth chambers in such a manner as to require a minimum amount of handling.  A diverging track system is provided in one of the growth chambers for handling the plants in a prescribed manner and guiding them through the chamber.  As the plants are moved through such chamber, increased space is automatically provided for plant growth.  The installation is well suited for growing plants hydroponically.

title: A device for detecting ion concentration of soilless cultivation culture liquid used in agriculture and forestry
abstract: The utility model discloses a soilless cultivation culture liquid ion concentration detection device used in agriculture and forestry, which comprises a casing 1, a detection module 11 arranged in the casing 1, a signal processing module 6 connected with the detection module 11 and The control module 7 that is connected with signal processing module 6; Control module 7 is also connected with ion concentration preset module 8; Described detection module 11 comprises potassium ion concentration sensor 31, calcium ion concentration sensor 41, chloride ion concentration sensor 51, potassium ion The concentration sensor 31 , the calcium ion concentration sensor 41 and the chloride ion concentration sensor 51 are connected to the potassium ion probe 3 , the calcium ion probe 4 and the chloride ion probe 5 outside the casing 1 . The detection device can quickly and conveniently grasp the ion concentration of each component in the culture solution, so as to meet the demand of plant nutrients in production.

title: Medium-free hydroponic cultivation device
abstract:
The present invention relates to a medium-free three-dimensional hydroponic cultivation apparatus using an air cap tube-type cultivation zone that does not have a shape change. As the air cap tubing is made of synthetic resin in the form of a thin vinyl film, as the crops seedlings grow, the air cap tubing does not overcome the weight of the weighted crop, and the air cap tubing is easily torn. The shape of the air cap tube is changed, and the direction of other crop roots (roots) is not changed so that smooth cultivation can be achieved. It is intended to solve the problems of the conventional medium-free three-dimensional hydroponic cultivation apparatus (utility model notification No. 90-3900) that can not be reused.

title: A hydroponic liquid level controller
abstract: A hydroponic liquid level controller, belonging to the field of crop irrigation devices, comprising a fixed tube and a rotating tube close to the inner wall of the fixed tube, a handle is fixed above the rotating tube, and round holes A, A, The round hole B and the long hole C, the left side, the right side and the front side of the rotating tube are respectively provided with the round hole I, the round hole II and the long hole III, and the round hole I, the round hole II and the long hole III are respectively connected with the round hole The heights of A, round hole B and long hole C correspond one by one. title: Plant solution cultivation method and apparatus therefor
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for hydroponically cultivating plants in a plant growth container filled with a solution and a device used therefor, wherein a nutrient solution is delivered in a root supply area, and the nutrient solution is delivered by continuously and periodically supplying the soil surface in a gas-liquid state according to the temperature of the surrounding air. The device comprises a nutrient solution reservoir, a water pump, and a plant growth container with a discharge pipe, and a nutrient solution sprayer in the form of a perforated pipe is arranged on the upper part thereof at a certain distance from the soil surface, and the total area of the small holes on the sprayer pipe is smaller than the cross-sectional area of the discharge pipe.

title: Method for growing stachys
abstract: Use: agriculture, in particular, cultivation under hydroponic conditions. The essence of the invention: the cultivation of stakhis is carried out by planting tubers in an expanded clay substrate for hydroponic installation of 16 pieces / m. A Knop nutrient solution with a 1.5-fold increase in the concentration of nutrients is supplied to the root system zone. During the period of intensive growth of green mass, 50 g of a crystal containing N: P: K - 20:16:10 are additionally introduced into the nutrient solution. A 10-hour photoperiod with an irradiance of 80-150 W / m2 and a temperature of 20-22 ° C during the period of growing green mass and 14-15 ° C during the formation of tubers around the clock is provided. Harvesting is done by preheating the substrate with water and then removing the plants from it. 1 hp f-ly.

title: An automatic cleaning device for planting trays
abstract: The utility model discloses an automatic cleaning device for planting trays, which belongs to the technical field of hydroponic plant production equipment. The utility model comprises a frame, a control mechanism, a transmission mechanism and a cleaning mechanism; and the control panel are arranged on the rack; the transmission mechanism is erected on the top of the rack, and a working channel for the planting tray to pass through is formed between the transmission mechanism and the rack; the cleaning mechanism includes a drive motor arranged in the rack, a water supply The device and two cleaning brushes, the driving motor is connected with the cleaning brush in transmission, and the water supply device is used to supply water to the working channel; the driving motor is electrically connected with the control panel. The utility model can realize automatic cleaning, is convenient, clean and fast, can reduce the working intensity of workers, improve the working environment, has good cleaning effect and high cleaning efficiency, and effectively improves the labor intensity of the traditional manual cleaning method.

title: A low-loss suction, pulling, cutting and stem harvesting device for hydroponic lettuce
abstract: The invention discloses a low-loss suction-pulling-cutting stem harvesting device for hydroponic lettuce, comprising: a frame, which serves as the main body support of the harvesting device; The pulling mechanism includes a fixed plate and a suction cup assembly. The fixed plate is installed on the longitudinal mechanical arm, and the suction cup assembly is arranged at the end of the fixed plate. The suction mechanism has two positions. In the first position, the suction mechanism is located just above the shearing mechanism. , used to adsorb and fix the hydroponic lettuce and lift it up. In the second position, the adsorption mechanism, driven by the mechanical arm, transports the sheared hydroponic lettuce to the collection area; the shearing mechanism is used for adsorption The mechanism sucks and pulls up the rhizomes of the hydroponic lettuce for shearing; the planting plate conveying mechanism, located just below the shearing mechanism, is used for placing and conveying the hydroponic lettuce. The device can realize low-damage suction, pulling, cutting, and harvesting of leafy facility vegetables such as hydroponic lettuce, without causing damage to the leaves.

title: A tunnel type planting platform mobile device
abstract: The invention discloses a tunnel-type planting platform moving device, which is characterized by comprising a tunnel, a planting platform and a plant growth promoting device. The invention creates a good growth space for plant planting through tunnels and planting platforms, avoids the influence of external natural factors, concentrates a sufficient amount of growth elements required by plants, helps shorten the growth cycle of plants, and stimulates plants to transform effective nutrients , grow healthily and vigorously; the tunnel is equipped with continuous long tunnels and segmented tunnels. The continuous long tunnels can be suitable for large-scale planting, and the segmented tunnels can be moved to the tunnels suitable for this stage of growth according to the growth period of plants. Inside, the growth factors are applied to promote the growth of plants at different stages; in hydroponics, the planting platform has three moving modes, so that the roots of the plants can be moved to the next sink smoothly, and different moving methods can be selected according to the growth habit of the plants to avoid Damage to plant roots; during fog farming, spray room fog farming or aerosol room fog farming can be selected according to the growth habit of plants.

title: New type of hydroponic tower
abstract: The utility model discloses a novel hydroponic tower, which comprises a bucket body for storing nutrient solution and a bucket cover covered above the bucket body, wherein the bucket body is provided with a water pump capable of pumping the nutrient solution, an outlet of the water pump is connected with a flow guide pipe for conveying the nutrient solution, the top end of the bucket cover is provided with a hydroponic tower body, and the bucket cover is also provided with a hole site for assembling the hydroponic tower body in an opposite-inserting way, so that the hydroponic tower body can be vertically assembled on the bucket cover, the hydroponic tower body is formed by stacking and combining a plurality of plant hydroponic module pipe bodies, the adjacent plant hydroponic module pipe bodies are stacked in a staggered way, the top of the hydroponic tower body is provided with a flow distribution module, the flow guide pipe penetrates through the hole site of the bucket cover and the hydroponic tower body and is connected with the flow distribution module so that the flow distribution module uniformly distributes the nutrient solution, the side wall inside the plant hydroponic module pipe body is obliquely and equidistantly and circularly provided with a plurality of planting basket placing grooves, and planting baskets for placing plants are obliquely and evenly placed inside the planting basket placing grooves.

title: Method for Water Culturing Using Culture Broth of Stem Cell from Velvet Antlers
abstract: The present invention relates to a hydroponic cultivation method of a plant, characterized in that a plant or plant seed is grown in cultivation water containing an antler-derived cell culture solution. In this case, it is possible to grow plants without diseases without the use of growth promoters or antibiotics, and there is an effect of cultivating safe edible crops.

title: A panoramic hydroponic device
abstract: This utility model discloses a panoramic hydroponic device, comprising a long, narrow cultivation trough. A water inlet pipe is located at the bottom of one end of the trough, and an overflow pipe is located at the other end. The opening of the overflow pipe is lower than the top of the cultivation trough. Several parallel floating plates float within the trough, each with a cultivation hole for planting plants. The advantages of this utility model are: simple structure, ability to display the daily growth status of plants, allowing students to observe the entire plant growth process intuitively in a short time, resulting in good demonstration and teaching effects.

title: Interlocking raft segment for deepwater culture hydroponics
abstract: Embodiments of a hydroponic growing system include raft segments that can be reversibly attached together to form a raft. Rafts can have one or more plant holes to support a plant body, and one or more thermal chimneys to provide for gas transport from underneath the raft to the upper surface, to control temperature and humidity of the plant. Additional embodiments include wireless sensors that may or may not be part of a raft, and a growing environment control system that can receive data from one or more sensors of environmental conditions of a plant and in other embodiments, can detect discrepancies between the actual environmental conditions and desired conditions. In still further embodiments, a growing environment control system can automatically adjust an actuator to return an environmental condition to a desired state.

title: A kind of hydroponic flowers control system
abstract: The utility model relates to a kind of flowers compounding and controlling system, specifically a kind of hydroponic flowers control system, comprises host computer (1), slave computer (3), sensor (5), equipment group (7); Described slave computer (3) is connected with host computer (1) by radio communication (2); Described slave computer (3) is connected with A/D modular converter (4), and A/D modular converter (4) is connected with sensor (5); Described slave computer (3) is connected with driving governor (6), and driving governor (6) is connected with equipment group (7); Described slave computer (3) is connected with TDS tester (11); Described slave computer (3) is connected with spray thrower (10), automatic constant temp. controller (9), Full automatic timer (8) when automatically controlling, the utility model structure is simple, easy to use, improve the efficiency that water planting flower is cultivated, save water resource.

title: Hydroponic bed and hydroponic device
abstract: (57) [Summary] [Structure] A hydroponic bed 1 in which a pot insertion recess 4 for inserting a pot for raising seedlings is formed on a bed upper surface 2, and a hydroponic cultivation apparatus using the hydroponic bed 1. . [Effect] The seedling raising pot 3 can be positioned. The seedlings of the seedlings on the hydroponic bed 1 are quickly established.

title: Indoor vegetable planting box with adjustable lighting
abstract: The present application discloses an indoor vegetable planting box with adjustable lighting, which relates to the field of indoor planting technology, including a support frame and a working mechanism. The upper end of the support frame is fixedly connected to the working mechanism. When in use, it provides comprehensive support for indoor vegetable planting. The charging component uses solar panels to collect solar energy and convert it into electrical energy. The inverter converts it for system use or stores it in a battery, ensuring stable power support even when there is no sunlight. This is not only environmentally friendly and energy-saving, but also reduces long-term operating costs. The water delivery component accurately controls the direction and flow of water through water pumps and distribution pipes to achieve automated management and efficient irrigation, reducing the waste of water resources. The planting component adopts hydroponics to provide plants with optimal nutrient absorption conditions, while improving space utilization and reducing the occurrence of soil-borne diseases. The drainage component and the circulation component collect and process excess water to achieve effective reuse of water resources.

title: Hydroponic cultivation apparatus
abstract: A hydroponic cultivation apparatus includes: a cultivation chamber underground portion internally including an underground space where a subterranean part of a plant grows such that the underground space is separated from above-ground space where aerial part of the plant grows; an underground temperature adjuster which adjusts a temperature of an atmosphere inside the underground space; and a controller which controls the underground temperature adjuster, in which the controller includes a dormancy determination unit which determines whether a time of cultivation of the plant is a dormant period when leaves of the aerial part wither, and a temperature controller which makes the underground temperature adjuster adjust the temperature of the atmosphere inside the underground space so as to facilitate germination of the plant in a case where the dormancy determination unit determines that the time of cultivation of the plant is the dormant period when leaves of the aerial part wither.

title: Hydroponic cultivation device and hydroponic cultivation method
abstract: This invention provides a hydroponic cultivation device and method for removing dust and bacteria from a cultivation trough. The hydroponic cultivation device of this invention includes a cultivation trough and a discharge component. The discharge component includes: a first discharge section, which is tubular and extends vertically through the bottom of the cultivation trough; a second discharge section, connected to the upper end of the first discharge section, which is funnel-shaped and expands upwards from the upper end; a liquid inlet hole formed on the peripheral wall of the second discharge section, allowing liquid stored in the cultivation trough to flow into the inner side of the second discharge section; a protrusion below the liquid inlet hole, protruding from the inner surface of the peripheral wall of the second discharge section along the circumference of the second discharge section, causing backflow of liquid flowing into the inner side of the second discharge section through the liquid inlet hole; and a cover, which is bowl-shaped, covering the first and second discharge sections from above, allowing liquid stored in the cultivation trough to flow into the inner side of the second discharge section through the liquid inlet hole.

title: Automatic irrigation methods and systems for soilless cultivation of crops in solar greenhouses
abstract: The invention provides an automatic irrigation method and system applied to soilless crops of a solar greenhouse, and relates to the technical field of solar greenhouses; the method comprises the steps of detecting a determined irrigation time based on an irrigation time interval by a cumulative radiation irrigation strategy, performing irrigation operation on soilless culture crops according to an irrigation time length determined by the cumulative radiation amount monitored outside a sunlight greenhouse, and performing irrigation operation on the soilless culture crops based on a preset irrigation time and an irrigation time length by a timing irrigation strategy. This scheme cost is lower, and keeps irrigation accuracy's stability strong.

title: Plant cultivation device and Internet of things plant cultivation system and plant cultivation display device
abstract: The utility model discloses a plant cultivating device, a plant cultivating system of the Internet of Things and a plant cultivating display device. The scheme cleverly integrates the soil cultivation box and the hydroponic cultivation box on the installation frame vertically, and combines the circulation water tank with the water circulation mechanism and the sprinkler irrigation mechanism. It realizes the spray irrigation cultivation of plants in the soil cultivation box and the hydroponic cultivation of the fabric in the hydroponic box. Since the water in the soil cultivation box and the hydroponic box is taken from the circulating water tank, the water source of the overall device, The nutrient solution can be prepared in a unified manner without separate replacement, just directly replace the water or nutrient solution in the hydroponic tank and clean it. This method simplifies the work of green plant cultivation and provides greater convenience for the cultivation personnel , in addition, this program also monitors the air environment and water environment of hydroponics and soil cultivation by introducing existing sensors. It is not only reliable in implementation, simple in structure, but also convenient in green plant cultivation and can reduce the manpower expenditure.

title: A drip irrigation device for soilless cultivation of green plants
abstract: The utility model discloses a drip irrigation device for soilless cultivation of green plants, which comprises two brackets, the bottom of the bracket is fixedly linked with two legs, the end of the legs away from the bracket is provided with a rubber sleeve, and the bracket A water pipe groove is arranged on the top of the water pipe, and the structure of the utility model is simple. The joint use of the hinge seat, the second hinge seat, the locking handle, the buckle, the card slot and the second silicone pad realizes the function of convenient installation and disassembly of the drip irrigation device, and the plants can be stuck in the two reservoirs according to different choices of plants. Between the tanks or the drip irrigation device is on the side of the plant. During the drip irrigation process, the liquid passes through the infusion pipe to the liquid storage tank, and is drained through the drip tube set at the bottom of the liquid storage tank. Waste during the dropper process.

title: Soilless culture planting tower
abstract: The utility model discloses a soilless cultivation planting tower, including a planting tower body, a liquid storage tank, a liquid supply pipe, a planting hole, a planting tube, a bracket and a water receiving tray. The planting tower body is a three-dimensional structure with a thick bottom and a thin top. The liquid storage tank is arranged at the bottom of the planting tower body, and the liquid supply pipe is arranged at the center of the liquid storage tank. The planting hole is arranged on the side wall of the planting tower body, and the planting tube is arranged at a position corresponding to the planting hole on the inner wall of the planting tower body. The bottom of the planting tube is provided with a drainage hole, and the planting tube is placed on the water receiving tray. The bracket is fixed on the inner wall of the planting tower body, and the water receiving tray is placed on the bracket. The soilless cultivation planting tower disclosed by the utility model can avoid the problem of light blocking between the upper and lower layers of crops, effectively increase the lighting effect, thereby solving the problems of low space utilization and poor crop lighting in the existing soilless cultivation, and energy consumption is saved by arranging the planting tube and the intelligent control system.

title: Novel high-efficient soilless culture system
abstract: The invention discloses a novel high-efficiency soilless culture system, belonging to the technical field of soilless culture. The invention realizes the related supporting technologies of the integrated soilless culture system, adopts a high degree of automation method to perform soilless culture on plants, and innovatively The self-adaptive growth net disk is introduced into the substrate to intervene and adjust the growth environment of each plant, forcing the nutrient solution to be evenly distributed in the root area, and to promote the vigorous growth of plants. The internal nutrient solution distribution is autonomously sensed, and when there is a shortage of nutrient solution in a local area, the magnetic field leakage action is triggered, so as to cooperate with the multi-point drip irrigation head above, and release a quantitative nutrient solution for fixed-point replenishment without human control intervention. It can realize self-adaptive cultivation between single plants and multiple plants, which can effectively fit the different growth conditions of plants, thereby greatly improving the quality of soilless cultivation of plants.

title: A method for constructing ecological floating islands for lakes
abstract: This invention discloses a method for constructing ecological floating islands for lakes, solving the problems of existing technologies where most ecological floating islands are constructed and planted on-site, resulting in long construction cycles, and the limited application range of ecological floating islands with the same structure, which are only suitable for planting one or a few types of plants. The invention includes a first step: preparing a plant fixing frame and a floating island body with through holes, and providing slots on the floating island body; the second step: fixing hydroponic plants onto the plant fixing frame, and then installing the plant fixing frame with the hydroponic plants onto the slots on the floating island body. This invention is applicable to the planting of all kinds of plants, and makes planting more convenient and saves planting time.

title: A kind of seedling frame for strawberry planting in soilless culture
abstract: The utility model discloses a seedling raising frame for strawberry planting in soilless culture, which comprises a base plate, a water tank, a first support plate, a first seedling raising pipe and a main support rod. A main support rod is fixed, a water tank is installed on the bottom plate outside the main support rod, the outside of the first support plate is fixed with the bottom plate through a vertical auxiliary support rod, and the first support plate outside the third support plate is A third seedling raising pipe is installed on the top, a seedling raising hole is installed on the third support plate outside the second support plate, and a first seedling raising pipe is installed on the upper end of the second support plate. The strawberry seedling raising rack for soilless culture is placed on the support by adopting a circular ring-shaped pipe, the strawberry seedlings are planted in the seedling hole, and the inside of the pipe is filled with a circulating nutrient solution, so as to form soilless cultivation and rationally utilize the space. Increasing the planting density can better carry out the nursery work of strawberry seedlings and promote the development of the strawberry planting industry.

title: A device for growing seedlings in water
abstract: This utility model discloses a hydroponic seedling device, including a hydroponic box. A water inlet is located at the top of the hydroponic box, and a cultivation cover is located inside the water inlet. The cultivation cover has a placement hole extending vertically. A water passage hole extending horizontally is located on the right side wall of the hydroponic box. A water level pipe is located outside the water passage hole, and the water level pipe has water level markings. The water level pipe closes the right end of the water passage hole. The water level pipe includes a horizontal pipe communicating with the water passage hole and a vertical pipe connected to the horizontal pipe and extending upwards. The vertical pipe communicates with the horizontal pipe and has water level markings. The water level pipe can rotate around the central axis of the horizontal pipe. The water level pipe has water level markings, thus displaying the water level with high accuracy. Furthermore, the water level pipe is rotatable, so when water needs to be poured out of the hydroponic box, simply rotate the water level pipe so that it faces downwards, making water pouring convenient. This utility model relates to the field of hydroponics.

title: Attachment for hydroponics, and hydroponic set
abstract: The hydroponics attachment 1 capable of steady growing of even taproot-type plant and easy plant relocation comprises : the cap member 3 with the opening 19 at its top, which is detachably screwed, via the threaded portion 28, on the mouth of the drink bottle 26; the bottomed cylinder-shaped case body 2 fitted in the opening 19; and the water-holding element 4 placed in the case body 2 for absorbing water in the drink bottle 26, so that hydroponics can be done with absorbed water. The single-piece water-holding element 4 is made of a plurality of aligned filaments. The case body 2 has, at its bottom, the insertion hole 24 for guiding the plant 27's root growing downward through the water-holding element 4 to go under the case body 2. The opening dimension of the insertion hole 24 is smaller than the outer dimension of the water-holding element 4.

abstract: The utility model discloses an assembled connection structure of a green plant wall surface true plant board, which comprises a wall hanging substrate for connecting a wallboard and a plant board hung on the wall hanging substrate, wherein a multidimensional growth base is paved in front of the plant board, a protective layer is wrapped outside the multidimensional growth base, two edge parts of the protective layer are fixed on the plant board through frames; simultaneously, this plant board is planted the plant through planting cotton, realizes the soilless cultivation of wall green plant, and whole plant board light in weight, simple to operate.

title: A process solution thermal control method and a plant for controlled environment aeroponics/hydroponics farm
abstract: The present invention is to create a Process Solution Temperature Control System for aeroponics/hydroponics driven controlled environment grow rooms located anywhere in the tropics and in the temperate climate zones, consuming less power compared to conventional systems by a unique logic making use of thermodynamic principles. The invention provides a system to solve this issue by combining wet cooling tower principle with vapor compression cycle and changing the mode of operation between three functional modes which are evaporative cooling mode, refrigerated cooling mode and refrigerated heating mode dynamically based on the conditions and state of the solution and the ambience.

title: A kind of hydroponic device and hydroponic method of gene editing tobacco single plant
abstract: The invention discloses a gene editing tobacco single plant water culture device and a water culture method, which comprise the following steps: a water culture cup (4), a planting cup (3), a water absorption line (7) and a water level observation pipe (8); the top of the water culture cup (4) is provided with a water culture cup cover (2), the planting cup (3) is fixed on the upper part of the water culture cup (4) through the water culture cup cover (2), and the planting cup (3) is internally provided with tobacco seedlings (1) and a substrate for culturing the tobacco seedlings (1); the water level observation pipe (8) is positioned inside the water culture cup (4) and is used for observing the water level height of the nutrient solution (5) in the water culture cup (4); the water culture cup (4) and the water culture cup cover (2) are black and light-tight. According to the invention, the single-plant water culture device is constructed, the nutrient solution of each plant is independently added, the exchange and sharing among plants of the nutrient solution are avoided, and the tobacco diseases are prevented from being cross-infected through nutrient solution exchange. In addition, the invention selects opaque materials or coats the opaque materials to solve the problem of water culture green algae breeding.

title: Foamed plastic profile member for hydroponic cultivation and growth of plants
abstract: A foamed plastic profile member as the carrier substance for the root space or accommodation during the hydroponic cultivation and growth of plants wherein the profile member is formed of one piece and - viewed in cross-section - possesses at its edge a recess bounded by a diaphragm at the side facing away from the profile member.

title: Plant hydroponics rack and plant-growth protection system
abstract: Provided is a plant hydroponics rack, comprising: a rack frame (1) provided with at least one level of a hydroponic space (10) therein. The interior of the hydroponic space (10) is provided with at least one culture tray (2) for containing a nutrient solution. The interior of the culture tray (2) is provided with a plant pot support (6) for supporting plant pots floating in the nutrient solution. The plant pot support (6) is provided with at least one plant pot (8) thereon, and the plant pot (8) is provided with a seed support (9) therein for obtaining water from the culture tray and supporting germination of the seeds placed in the seed support (9). The present invention also provides a plant-growth protection system suitable for use in a plant hydroponics rack.

title: Apparatus for growing buckwheat bud
abstract: The present invention relates to a buckwheat sprout planter that increases freshness and grows faster than the growing process, allows the buckwheat skin to be naturally peeled off by friction with each other during the growing process, and can remove various odors caused by hydroponic cultivation. A housing 10 having a compartment for accommodating buckwheat sprout by installing a frame 12 at an edge of the bottom plate 16 on which a plurality of through holes 14 are formed; A nonwoven fabric 20 laminated on the bottom plate 16 of the enclosure 10; 2 to 5 mm sized sand 30 stacked on the nonwoven fabric 20 with a thickness of 5 mm; detachable to the upper side of the housing 10 so that the shell is naturally removed as the buckwheat settled on the sand 30 grows. It is configured to include the reticular body 40 having a mesh of 4 ~ 5mm size installed possible, through the net of each of the reticular buckwheat sprouts usually comes out 2-4 pieces of buckwheat peeled naturally, so that the growth of the buckwheat does not decrease Not only can the yield be increased, but it is also effective in preventing the odor from the buckwheat and the peeled skin that has not germinated in the enclosure.

title: Hydroponics planter
abstract: The invention relates to a planter (10) forming part of a hydroponic system. The planter (10) includes a longitudinal body (12) defining at least two longitudinally extending liquid channels (14.1,14.2) and at least two plant holders (16,18) defined in the body (12), the plant holders (16,18) spaced on the outer circumference of the longitudinal body (12), each one of the at least two plant holders (16,18) in fluid flow communication with one of the at least two longitudinally extending liquid channels (14.1,14.2).

title: Method and systems for indoor farming
abstract: A method of providing light to plants. The method comprises providing a plurality of plants within a room, grouping each plant of the plurality of plants into one of a plurality of groups of plants based at least in part on a desired total light integral ("TLI") for each of the plurality of plants and providing the corresponding desired TLI to each plant of the plurality of plants by sequentially providing light to each of the plurality of groups of plants during a time period. For each group of plants, each plant has a substantially similar photoperiod and a sum of the photosynthetic photon flux densities ("PPFDs") of all plants in the group of plants is substantially similar.

title: Artificial aquatic plant floating island
abstract: The utility model discloses an artificial aquatic plant floating island, and relates to the technical field of plant floating islands. The utility model comprises the following steps: the H-shaped steel frame is horizontally arranged on the water surface; the air floatation device is detachably arranged at the bottom of the H-shaped steel frame through a connecting piece; the rectangular long frames are provided with a plurality of rectangular long frames, and one ends of the rectangular long frames are respectively and detachably horizontally arranged on the outer sides of the four supporting rods of the H-shaped steel frame; the bottom of the planting grid is hollow, the number of the planting grids is a plurality of the planting grids, and the planting grids are sequentially and detachably connected with the rectangular long frame along the length direction of the rectangular long frame; and (5) protecting the net frame. The utility model provides buoyancy for the H-shaped steel frame and the structure arranged on the H-shaped steel frame through air floatation, so that the device can be kept on the water surface, and a plurality of horizontally arranged rectangular long frames are detachably arranged at the outer sides of four supporting rods of the H-shaped steel frame, and a plurality of planting grids for directly hydroponics plants are detachably arranged in the rectangular long frames.

title: A soilless cultivation method for pyrethrum
abstract: This invention discloses a soilless cultivation method for pyrethrum, belonging to the field of agricultural planting technology. The method includes: (1) using a mixture of perlite:vermiculite:peat moss in a volume ratio of 1:1:1 as the cultivation substrate; (2) transplanting pyrethrum seedlings in a greenhouse at a spacing of 40cm×40cm; (3) fertilization management, applying base fertilizer before transplanting, and top-dressing with a nutrient solution with a nitrogen-phosphorus-potassium ratio of N:  P₂O₅  :  K₂O  =  14  :15:16 and a concentration of 5000 mg/kg during the growing season; (4) controlling the temperature and humidity in the greenhouse; and (5) data monitoring and harvesting. This invention significantly improves the plant height, leaf area, and survival rate during flowering of pyrethrum through an optimized soilless cultivation system, effectively overcomes soil-borne diseases, and achieves a reduction of more than 80% in chemical fertilizer use. It has the advantages of high yield, high quality, fertilizer saving, and environmental protection, and is particularly suitable for the industrial cultivation of pyrethrum in soil-poor areas and ecologically sensitive areas such as the Yunnan Plateau.
